text: The Fed just hiked rates to 3.75%-4% while September payrolls came in at only 29,000 jobs — this combination of tightening into a weakening labor market raises the risk of a policy mistake that could drag stocks lower, so be cautious adding new risk right now.
Trim IONQ — it's down 13%, nearly 48% off its high, burning cash with 10% short interest, and speculative quantum computing names are especially vulnerable in a rising-rate environment.
Raise your stop on Bloom Energy from $216.84 to $228.13 to lock in more of your gains while the stock still rides bullish momentum above its 50-day average.
Google looks like a solid add here — a PE of 23 is reasonable for 15% revenue growth, free cash flow is strong, and insider buying signals confidence from people who know the business best.

Consider adding to UnitedHealth while it's down about 9% — the MACD (a momentum indicator) is turning positive, suggesting the pullback may be finding a floor at an attractive price for a blue-chip healthcare name.
